title: Vector-Symbolic Intelligence in Practice

sourceEvidence.excerpt: “Alice helps Bob” and “Bob helps Alice” therefore produced exactly equal vectors. Larger dimension cannot restore an actor–recipient distinction that the encoding removed. Role binding can preserve extracted roles, but it cannot solve ambiguous parsing by itself. A separate character-drift metric counted listed traits rather than checking temporal consistency. Both findings show why a metric or representation needs an explicit semantic contract. Prediction, compression and misleading success sco
